event_summary: A stationary close-up of an ornate screen shows warm illumination while soft dark patterns move and change shape across the mesh surface.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a close view of a decorative mesh panel and dark curled metal bars. A warm bright area covers much of the center-right mesh. Soft-edged dark patterns are already visible on the bright mesh, and over the clip these patterns shift, stretch, and fade in different areas while the metal frame, scroll shapes, and mesh panel remain fixed in the image. No object enters or exits the main panel area.

reasons: The mesh panel, decorative metal curls, bright area, and dark patterns are visible from the start.
The visible change is already underway in the first frame.
The source of the changing dark patterns is not visible within the frame.
